==Behind the scenes==
Alderaanian flame-lilies were mentioned in a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' character profile included with [[Laurie Burns]]' short story "[[Ringers (short story)|Ringers]]," published in the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal6" />
